resources.string: Choose what the dash shows when you connect with this screen instead of Android Auto. The first widget is drawn large.
Connect to your bike once first (scan the dash QR).
On the bike, handlebar buttons: ▼ or OK = full-screen map (any template) · ▲ = hide the right panel · ◀ ▶ = previous / next song · knob = zoom · Back = normal view.
Only this template changes; each template keeps its own colours.
Untick what you don\'t want on this template. The rest closes up the gap.
Above this speed the number turns red and the frame flashes. The gauge\'s red zone starts here too.
Darkens the dash after dark (follows the map\'s day/night setting).
The needle sweeps to the top and back when the dash comes on, like a new bike.
Your bike\'s name lights up for 2 seconds before the dash appears.
The needle and speed glide to each new value instead of jumping.
The gauge glows brighter the faster you go and turns red near the red zone.

The bike doesn\'t send its fuel level to the phone. The fuel gauge, the grid\'s Fuel widget and the low-fuel station finder estimate it from this tank size and your refuel log. Log every fill-up (full tank).
Default for your %1$s: %2$s L (maker\'s spec). Clear the box to go back to it.
🎵🧭 Show songs and Google Maps / Waze turns on the dash

For song titles and the turns of Google Maps / Waze, Android needs "Notification access" for ZRide Screen. It reads only music sessions and those navigation apps\' turn notification; nothing else is read, stored or sent. ◀ ▶ on the handlebar change track even without it.
Every template shows the next turn: from the app\'s Map screen (Go) and from Google Maps or Waze on the phone. Off = the Map screen\'s navigation uses the full map dash as before.
